title: Cute !!
text: Cute !!. I have been collecting plant heads for a while and I really like these. There are so cute. They are nice and small and fit on any shelf Or plant area. I have only 1 issue With 1 of them being a bit wobbly and not as sturdy as the other 2 it has a tendency to be top heavy and sometimes fall back. It feels like it's made out of a ceramic But It's not shiny so maybe it's just hard plastic with a good weight to it.
